detail: Secondary school in Cork city; he grew up in the Turners Cross area.

He became active in politics at UCC as a member of the Ógra Fianna Fáil branch, later serving as the youth wing's national chairman. His MA thesis was published in 2009 as 'Freedom to Choose: Cork and Party Politics in Ireland 1918–1932' (The Collins Press). He then completed a Higher Diploma in Education; the sources consulted do not say at which institution.
